We assume that the all_data dataframe exists in the environment, which comes from `second_foray_lowpass.qmd` (because I haven't had time to clean these files up oops!)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```

```{r}
all_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = V1)) +
  geom_density()

all_data %>% 
  filter(V1 > 0.2, language == "Hmong")
```


```{r}
svmData <- all_data %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(phonation = as.factor(phonation)) %>% 
  mutate(language = as.factor(language)) %>% 
  mutate(language = as.factor(LPhon)) %>% 
  # dplyr::select(-token_id, -LPhon, -tone_misc) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-token_id, -tone_misc) %>% 
  dplyr::select(LPhon, CQ_H, SQ, SQ2_SQ1, SQ4_SQ3, peak_Vel, min_Vel, H1H2c, H2H4c, H1A1c, H1A2c, H1A3c, strF0, CPP, Energy, V1:V4) %>% dplyr::select(-V1, -V2, -V3, -V4)
  # dplyr::select(phonation, V1, V2, V3, V4)


# select(-LPhon, -token_id, -tone_misc) %>% # EVERYTHING (within reason)
  # select(phonation:SQ) %>% # removes V1-V4
  # select(phonation, strF0, H1H2c, H2H4c, CPP, CQ_H, SQ, Energy, HNR05, HNR15, HNR25, HNR35, V1, V2, V3, V4) # curated list
svmData
```


```{r}
svm_spec <- svm_rbf() %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("kernlab")
```

```{r}
svm_recipe <- recipe(LPhon ~ ., data = svmData) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) # Centers and scales predictors
```

```{r}
svm_workflow <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(svm_recipe) %>%
  add_model(svm_spec)
```

```{r}
set.seed(222)
svm_cv <- svm_workflow %>% 
  fit_resamples(
    LPhon ~ .,
    resamples = vfold_cv(svmData, v = 10), 
    control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE, event_level = 'second'),
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy)
  )

svm_cv %>% 
  collect_metrics()

# CV acc was 0.7246105 without V1-V4,
# ....and 0.7237493 with it??? how!! boo.
# removing step_corr didn't do anything either.

# current curated list gives 0.6720065,and adding V1-V4 DOES NOT DO ANYTHING!!! BOOOO!!!!

# yeah my curated list did the same thing

# on language task: 80.9% w/o PCs, ... 83.1% with them. that's.... something??

# Lphon prediction is 61.7% with PCs, 62% without. damn!!
```
